messages:
deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT FAIL for release rls-513 — parity check failed between staging and prod. Blocking promotion.
Diff snippets from preflight:```diff
- model.variant: unpinned
+ model.variant: rc-2026-03-20-v2-small
- s3.cache_prefix: inference_cache/
+ s3.cache_prefix: inference-cache/
- kms.alias: alias/redwood-prod
+ kms.alias: alias/redwood-staging
```
Action: confirm rollback or patch before promotion. Link: https://ci.internal/releases/rls-513

maria (eng-release): Ack. Was the staging deploy the only one that applied the pin? I thought we documented pin in the release notes.

jon (backend): We merged the pin into staging helm values but it didn't make it into prod values.yaml — looks like a merge conflict got auto-resolved. That explains the unpinned prod. Cache prefix mismatch is scary because it can cause cross-variant hit/deser issues.

amy (release-manager): Change window is 11:00-13:00 PDT. Prod canary started at ~10:52. We need a quick decision: rollback or emergency patch. Prefer minimal blast radius.

raj (platform): If we patch prod now we'll have two incompatible runtime states (unpinned requests already in-flight). Rollback to previous prod image, then apply a hotfix PR to sync values. Safer.

sre-oncall: Observed intermittent 500s from model-service that correlate with cache mismatch errors. Traffic is small but trending. I support rollback to avoid user-visible errors. I'll pause canary and hold traffic.

maria (eng-release): I'll prepare rollback steps. Plan:
1) `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-service --to-revision=3`
2) re-run deploybot preflight locally `./scripts/preflight --env=prod --release=rls-513`
3) merge hotfix to helm values (pin + normalize cache_prefix)

jon (backend): Also worth calling out: KMS alias rotation was partially applied in staging; prod still points at the old alias. Don't rotate alias during patch — we need alias parity. Add explicit note to release notes: DO NOT ROTATE KMS ALIAS during this promotion.

amy (release-manager): @sre-oncall please hold the canary until rollback completes and smoke tests pass. I'll update release notes and notify support.

sre-oncall: Canary paused. Alerts on. Will not resume until rollout is validated. Ping me when rollback is done.

deploy-bot: Action logged: promotion blocked, rollback requested by @maria (eng-release), canary paused by @sre-oncall. CI link: https://ci.internal/releases/rls-513/status

maria (eng-release): Hotfix MR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/helm/merge_requests/789 — pins model.variant, normalizes s3.cache_prefix to `inference-cache/`, and documents KMS alias freeze. Will merge after rollback verification.

amy (release-manager): Decision: rollback prod -> merge hotfix -> re-run preflight -> re-promote within change window. I'll draft release-note addendum and post to #support.

jon (backend): I'll follow up with infra on the alias state. We'll avoid any KMS changes until after promotion.

sre-oncall: Standing by. Updating incident timeline.

deploy-bot: Update: rollback initiated by @maria at 1758890300, canary remained paused. Next steps: wait for smoke pass then re-run preflight.
